articles.title: Polymarket to challenge France’s nationwide website block
articles.snippet: France’s regulator has said the platform still promoted illegal gambling and cited loss, identity-check and market-manipulation risks.

articles.title: Bitcoin wilts as oil and rates rise. Clarity Act odds tumble to 38%
articles.snippet: Geopolitical risks, rising rates, and fresh regulatory setbacks send crypto lower as key Democrats demand stronger safeguards in the market structure bill.

articles.title: Pakistan Launches Crypto Investigation Unit to Fight Money Laundering
articles.snippet: Islamabad is building the enforcement side of its crypto push, standing up a unit to police money laundering even as it licenses exchanges.
